inputs: NIST SP 800-17 Appendix B Table 1 (commonly cited as Table B.1) variable-plaintext KAT #0 and the FIPS 81 Table B1 ECB example; encryption and decryption in the teaching implementation and OpenSSL 3DES equal-key mode
expected: Both vectors match, decryption restores the plaintext, and the two independent implementations agree
limitations: Two fixed known-answer cases; they check algorithm correctness, not implementation security or protocol use.

inputs: The standard PC-1, shift and PC-2 tables applied to the fixed key 0101010101010101 and a deterministic sample
expected: PC-1 excludes all eight parity positions and yields 56 bits; sixteen subkeys of 48 bits are produced; the halves return to their starting state after 16 rounds
limitations: Checks structural counts and table use, not the cryptographic quality of the key schedule.

inputs: 2^56 and assumed search rates of 10^9 and 10^12 keys per second
limitations: Pure arithmetic estimate; real searches add candidate filtering, key verification and parallel overhead.

inputs: The four published DES weak keys and 65,536 fixed 64-bit blocks built from repeating a 16-bit counter
expected: Each weak key satisfies E(E(P))=P for every tested block, and the four keys are distinct
limitations: A finite sample over structured blocks; the involution property follows from identical subkeys, not from the sample alone.

inputs: 128 deterministic keys, each applied to 128 deterministic blocks (16,384 cases)
expected: E with the bitwise-complemented key maps the bitwise-complemented plaintext to the bitwise complement of E(K,P)
limitations: Verifies the structural complementation identity on a finite sample; it is not an attack.

inputs: All eight S-boxes and their four rows
expected: Each of the 32 rows is a permutation of 0…15; each S-box has 64 entries
limitations: Checks the published table shape, not differential or linear resistance.

expected: FP(IP(x))=x and IP(FP(x))=x for every tested block
limitations: Positional-permutation identity only; it does not test the rounds.
